identifiedBy.fact: Start: Lassen Peak Trailhead; the park's own page for the Lassen Peak trail

notes: Route is the park's maintained trail, the only trail up Lassen Peak. All three placements within ~70 m. Parking point is the lot.

Peakbagger unresponsive (fetches timed out). Earlier pass only names Mineral King generally (climber.org 1998/355), not the exact lot, and the High Sierra Trail side is an alternative; no page ties the standard route to one start. Left stuck.
Text offers Cartridge Pass or Marion Lake; starts could be Roads End or Taboose/Sawmill. Peakbagger unresponsive; no page opened naming one start for this ridge.
Two equally used starts: Quartz Mountain (USFS 37.530826,-119.447315) and Mono Meadow/Glacier Point road. Peakbagger unresponsive; not resolved.
Own text: multi-day approach to Colby Lake, Cloud Canyon; candidate starts Crescent Meadow, Roads End/Sugarloaf via Colby Pass, all multi-day. Not resolved.
Shepherd Pass (east) and Cloud Canyon (west) both page-confirmed; no page says which is the standard route.

identifiedBy.fact: Mokelumne Peak climbed from Tanglefoot Trailhead, the usual quick approach

placements.source: climber.org trip report (printed coordinates, DMS converted)
placements.name: Tanglefoot Trailhead

notes: Placements agree within ~20 m. Identification still rests on Tanglefoot being the commonly used start (alternatives: Munson Meadows, winter Hwy 88); no land-manager placement (not in USFS list). Weak-ish; recommend hold.
Many ways, none standard (Balch Park Road, Hidden Falls, Kings Canyon east); no single start.

identifiedBy.fact: Cross Kearsarge Pass, leave the trail near the Charlotte Lake junction

notes: Kearsarge Pass is crossed from Onion Valley; west-side approach from Cedar Grove would not cross the pass. USFS point is named Campground, but agrees with OSM trailhead within ~10 m.

identifiedBy.fact: Follow the trail up from Convict Lake to Bright Dot Lake

notes: The USFS Convict Lake Trail point and OSM agree (~5 m) at the lake's trail start; the other USFS point is ~600 m north, probably the road-side lot lower down. I could not confirm which is the lot, so recommend the lake-side pair only if the owner accepts that. Route text itself says from Convict Lake.
Three real approaches (Whitney Portal, Shepherd Pass, George Creek); no standard identified.

identifiedBy.fact: Baxter Pass Trailhead start; class 2 SW slope via Baxter Pass trail

notes: USFS and OSM agree within ~5 m. Class 2 SW slope is the easy route from Baxter Pass trail in two reports; Sawmill Pass and Onion Valley serve other routes.
